verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a SaaS communications platform with a public API, so the axis applies. The evidence documents a REST API, OpenAPI specs, a Try-it playground, Claude/ChatGPT connectors and a public MCP server, but nothing shows an official command-line tool. Those are adjacent building blocks or different stories and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
